title: Magic Xylophone
shortDescription: Bandit uses Bluey as a pretend piano, in which Bingo begs to have a turn.
fullSynopsis: Bandit uses Bluey as a pretend piano, in which Bingo begs to have a turn. When they rediscover a magical xylophone which can freeze Bandit in a position, she gets upset that Bluey is not sharing the toy with her. Bluey learns that taking turns is an important part of playing.

title: Hospital
shortDescription: Bandit is admitted into an imaginary hospital, where Bingo is acting as the nurse and Bluey becomes the doctor.
fullSynopsis: Bandit is admitted into an imaginary hospital, where Bingo is acting as the nurse and Bluey becomes the doctor. They perform an operation on Bandit to relieve him from his stomach pains, pretending that there is a cat stuck inside him that needs to be lured out.

title: Keepy Uppy
shortDescription: Bluey blows up her last balloon and plays a game of 'keepy uppy' with Bingo, where they must try to keep the balloon in the air for as long as possible.
fullSynopsis: Bluey blows up her last balloon and plays a game of 'keepy uppy' with Bingo, where they must try to keep the balloon in the air for as long as possible. The sisters call upon Bandit to make the game more challenging, which leads to an outdoor chase to protect the balloon from popping on the grass.

title: Daddy Robot
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo summon 'Daddy Robot' to tidy their playroom, with Bandit pretending to follow their commands.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo summon 'Daddy Robot' to tidy their playroom, with Bandit pretending to follow their commands. However, when the robot malfunctions, Bluey and Bingo realise the importance of cleaning up their messes themselves.

title: Shadowlands
shortDescription: While on a picnic, Bluey plays a game of 'Shadowlands' with Snickers and Coco, where they must travel across the park by only stepping on shadows.
fullSynopsis: While on a picnic, Bluey plays a game of 'Shadowlands' with Snickers and Coco, where they must travel across the park by only stepping on shadows. Bluey tries to teach Coco how to solve problems and follow the rules instead of taking shortcuts to make the game easier.

title: The Weekend
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo are excited to spend the weekend at home playing games with Bandit.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo are excited to spend the weekend at home playing games with Bandit. While Bingo is pretending to be a magical statue that mysteriously moves around, she finds a walking leaf insect, but is upset when Bandit is too preoccupied with the game to notice her calling.

title: BBQ
shortDescription: Bandit and Chilli host a barbecue for Uncle Stripe and Aunt Trixie, while Bluey and Bingo roleplay their own barbecue with their cousins Muffin and Socks.
fullSynopsis: Bandit and Chilli host a barbecue for Uncle Stripe and Aunt Trixie, while Bluey and Bingo roleplay their own barbecue with their cousins Muffin and Socks. Bingo is tasked with preparing the salad, and searches the garden for the best plants to use.

title: Fruitbat
shortDescription: At bedtime, Bluey is disappointed the day is over and is unwilling to go to sleep.
fullSynopsis: At bedtime, Bluey is disappointed the day is over and is unwilling to go to sleep. She learns that fruit bats are nocturnal and wishes that she could become one herself to be able to stay awake during the night. She decides to dream of being a fruit bat instead.

title: Horsey Ride
shortDescription: Bluey forgets to put her special toy away when her cousins and Uncle Stripe come to visit, leading Socks to find the toy and insist on gnawing on it.
fullSynopsis: Bluey forgets to put her special toy away when her cousins and Uncle Stripe come to visit, leading Socks to find the toy and insist on gnawing on it. The children decide to imagine their fathers are horses and stage a horse wedding to distract Socks from chewing on Bluey's toy.

title: Hotel
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo run a pretend hotel at home, where Bandit books a room for the night and asks not to be disturbed.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo run a pretend hotel at home, where Bandit books a room for the night and asks not to be disturbed. The sisters intrude on their guest's night, but Bingo gets upset when Bluey is being bossy and makes all of the decisions with their game.

title: Bike
shortDescription: Bluey becomes discouraged while learning to ride a bike, and notices that her friends and family around her are struggling with challenges of their own.
fullSynopsis: Bluey becomes discouraged while learning to ride a bike, and notices that her friends and family around her are struggling with challenges of their own. She watches as they find the determination to overcome their obstacles and is inspired to persevere with her own goal.

title: Bob Bilby
shortDescription: Bingo is given her kindergarten's class puppet, Bob Bilby, to take home for the weekend.
fullSynopsis: Bingo is given her kindergarten's class puppet, Bob Bilby, to take home for the weekend. Bluey and Bandit help Bingo take photographs of Bob Bilby for the scrapbook, but when the family realises they are spending too much time using technology, they set out to make Bob Bilby's visit the most exciting one yet.

title: Spy Game
shortDescription: During a community barbecue at the park, Bluey and Bingo pretend to be spies on a mission with their friends.
fullSynopsis: During a community barbecue at the park, Bluey and Bingo pretend to be spies on a mission with their friends. When Bingo stops playing and the game starts to fall apart, Bluey realises her sister's importance to the team and persuades her to rejoin the game.

title: Takeaway
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo join Bandit to collect his takeaway dinner, but must wait with him at the restaurant until his order is completed.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo join Bandit to collect his takeaway dinner, but must wait with him at the restaurant until his order is completed. Bandit tries to control his restless children while they wait, but ultimately realises that they should be allowed to have fun while they are still young.

title: Butterflies
shortDescription: Bingo feels intimidated by Bluey's friend Judo while they are playing together, reenacting the life cycle of a butterfly.
fullSynopsis: Bingo feels intimidated by Bluey's friend Judo while they are playing together, reenacting the life cycle of a butterfly. When Judo encourages Bluey to abandon her sister and play elsewhere, Bingo is saddened. Bluey returns to apologise and they all learn how to play together.

title: Yoga Ball
shortDescription: While Bandit spends the day working from home, Bluey and Bingo steal the yoga ball chair from his desk and insist that he play with them.
fullSynopsis: While Bandit spends the day working from home, Bluey and Bingo steal the yoga ball chair from his desk and insist that he play with them. Bingo feels disheartened when Bandit is being too rough with her while playing games, and with Chilli's help, she asks him to be more gentle.

title: Calypso
shortDescription: Calypso facilitates a day at school and assists the children as they all engage in imaginative play together.
fullSynopsis: Calypso facilitates a day at school and assists the children as they all engage in imaginative play together. Among the various games, Bluey runs a pretend fish and chip shop and hires Indy to work as a waitress, while Pretzel takes time to think of something to play.

title: The Doctor
shortDescription: Bluey works at an imaginary doctor's office, managing the appointments for Bingo while she pretends to be the doctor.
fullSynopsis: Bluey works at an imaginary doctor's office, managing the appointments for Bingo while she pretends to be the doctor. Honey conjures up a pretend injury, but is disappointed when a long queue of walk-in patients take precedence over her in being attended to.

title: The Claw
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo find a claw machine at a local complex and are disappointed when they are unable to win a prize.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo find a claw machine at a local complex and are disappointed when they are unable to win a prize. Chilli and Bandit create their own imaginary claw game at home to cheer them up, and Bandit tries to teach the children a lesson in the process.

title: Markets
shortDescription: After a visit from the tooth fairy to reward a lost tooth, Bluey decides to spend the money she received at the local markets.
fullSynopsis: After a visit from the tooth fairy to reward a lost tooth, Bluey decides to spend the money she received at the local markets. Bluey searches the stalls for somewhere to make a purchase, but struggles to find an option that both she and Indy can enjoy together.

title: Blue Mountains
shortDescription: Bluey, Bingo, and Chilli roleplay a story about two sisters and a fairy who journey across the Blue Mountains.
fullSynopsis: Bluey, Bingo, and Chilli roleplay a story about two sisters and a fairy who journey across the Blue Mountains. They use their hands as puppet characters and pretend Bandit is the mountains while he sleeps. The characters encounter a suspicious fox when Bandit awakes.

title: The Pool
shortDescription: Bandit, Bluey, and Bingo leave in rush for Uncle Stripe's pool and neglect to bring their important swimming equipment, including pool floats, sunscreen, and rashies.
fullSynopsis: Bandit, Bluey, and Bingo leave in rush for Uncle Stripe's pool and neglect to bring their important swimming equipment, including pool floats, sunscreen, and rashies. The trio struggle to enjoy the hot day without the equipment, which Chilli later brings, teaching them that boring tasks are still important.

title: Shops
shortDescription: Bluey and her friends set up a pretend shop for a roleplaying game.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and her friends set up a pretend shop for a roleplaying game. Mackenzie becomes frustrated when Bluey spends too long making up rules and deciding the details of the scenario. The friends learn how to assign suitable roles to each other in order to enjoy the game.

title: Wagon Ride
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo ride in a wagon, pulled by Bandit, while on their way to the monkey bars.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo ride in a wagon, pulled by Bandit, while on their way to the monkey bars. Bluey and Bandit develop a strategy to prevent her agitation when he stops to talk to other adults. Bluey learns a lesson in patience by watching Bingo entertain herself.

title: Taxi
shortDescription: Bluey drives a pretend taxi, with Bandit and Bingo acting as passengers being transported to the airport, while Chilli provides the voice for the imaginary satellite navigation device.
fullSynopsis: Bluey drives a pretend taxi, with Bandit and Bingo acting as passengers being transported to the airport, while Chilli provides the voice for the imaginary satellite navigation device. When the car breaks down, Bandit is forced to run on foot in order to board his flight.

title: The Beach
shortDescription: On a family trip to the beach, Chilli decides to go for a walk by herself, and when Bluey wants to join her, she follows her mother's footsteps along the shore and enjoys the sights along the way.
fullSynopsis: On a family trip to the beach, Chilli decides to go for a walk by herself, and when Bluey wants to join her, she follows her mother's footsteps along the shore and enjoys the sights along the way. While walking alone for the first time, she tries to be brave, and eventually catches up to her mother.

title: Pirates
shortDescription: Bluey, Bingo, and Missy pretend to be pirates on the hammock swing at the playground.
fullSynopsis: Bluey, Bingo, and Missy pretend to be pirates on the hammock swing at the playground. Missy is frightened of the rough journey on the imaginary ship, but faces her fear to rescue her friends from inside the stomach of a whale.

title: Grannies
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo dress up as grandmothers, but disagree on if grandmothers are able to perform the floss dance or not.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo dress up as grandmothers, but disagree on if grandmothers are able to perform the floss dance or not. Bluey proves that they are not by video calling Nana, but when this upsets Bingo, Bluey decides to teach Nana the dance so that Bingo will keep playing.

title: The Creek
shortDescription: Bandit takes Bluey, Bingo, and Mackenzie to the creek after they grow tired of the local playground.
fullSynopsis: Bandit takes Bluey, Bingo, and Mackenzie to the creek after they grow tired of the local playground. Bluey struggles to appreciate the beauty of the natural world surrounding her, until they arrive at the water. Bluey learns to step out of her comfort zone and try new things.

title: Fairies
shortDescription: When the Heelers suspects that their house has been invaded by fairies, they go on a hunt to search for and capture the invisible creatures.
fullSynopsis: When the Heelers suspects that their house has been invaded by fairies, they go on a hunt to search for and capture the invisible creatures. Bandit accidentally hurts Bingo's feelings and makes it up to her by outsmarting the fairies.

title: Work
shortDescription: When Bingo is sick and in the hospital, she receives a video from Bluey; a short film she has made with Bandit and the family.
fullSynopsis: When Bingo is sick and in the hospital, she receives a video from Bluey; a short film she has made with Bandit and the family. The story is about a young dog called Bumpy who gets sick and her owner, Barnicus, who supports her through the period of difficulty.

title: Trampoline
shortDescription: Bandit plays on the trampoline with Bluey and Bingo before he has to leave for work.
fullSynopsis: Bandit plays on the trampoline with Bluey and Bingo before he has to leave for work. The sisters devise a plan to get him to stay; pretending to feed him breakfast on the trampoline. Before leaving, Bandit tells Bluey that she has an important job too: to continue making up games.

title: The Dump
shortDescription: Bluey, Bingo, Muffin and Socks roleplay a pretend backpacking adventure around the backyard.
fullSynopsis: Bluey, Bingo, Muffin and Socks roleplay a pretend backpacking adventure around the backyard. The children become the backpacks as Chilli and Bandit are tasked with carrying them around while exploring their holiday destination.

title: Sleepover
shortDescription: Muffin arrives at Bluey and Bingo's house for a sleepover in an extremely tired state due to her transitioning from her daily naps.
fullSynopsis: Muffin arrives at Bluey and Bingo's house for a sleepover in an extremely tired state due to her transitioning from her daily naps. The sisters stay up late and play a game with Muffin, before helping her get to sleep when they realise she is exhausted.

title: Early Baby
shortDescription: When Rusty and Indy's two separate games at Bluey's playgroup come into conflict, the groups explain their different activities to each other.
fullSynopsis: When Rusty and Indy's two separate games at Bluey's playgroup come into conflict, the groups explain their different activities to each other. After sharing, the friends find common ground with their games, and Rusty and Indy decide to play together.

title: Mums and Dads
shortDescription: Rusty and Indy have a disagreement about which parent should work while playing 'Mums and Dads', leading them to play separately.
fullSynopsis: Rusty and Indy have a disagreement about which parent should work while playing 'Mums and Dads', leading them to play separately. However, when they find that their friends have different ideas about how to play the game, the pair return to playing with each other again.

title: Hide and Seek
shortDescription: Bluey plays hide and seek with Bingo, Chilli and Bandit, but is quickly distracted by her toys, leaving her family hiding around the house undiscovered.
fullSynopsis: Bluey plays hide and seek with Bingo, Chilli and Bandit, but is quickly distracted by her toys, leaving her family hiding around the house undiscovered. When she slows down and focuses, Bluey remembers the game and successfully finds her family.

title: Mount Mumandad
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo pretend that Chilli and Bandit are a mountain when they are tasked with playing a game without their parents' participation.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo pretend that Chilli and Bandit are a mountain when they are tasked with playing a game without their parents' participation. Bluey races ahead to reach the summit while Bingo brings along a backpack to carry the climbing equipment.

title: Kids
shortDescription: During a visit to the supermarket, Bluey adopts the role of the parent while Bandit must act as the child alongside Bingo.
fullSynopsis: During a visit to the supermarket, Bluey adopts the role of the parent while Bandit must act as the child alongside Bingo. When he tries to fill the shopping trolley with the groceries, Bandit gets in trouble with Bluey for being a disobedient child.

title: Chickenrat
shortDescription: Before bed, Bingo loses her favourite cuddly toy (Floppy), so Chilli and Bluey help retrace her steps to find it.
fullSynopsis: Before bed, Bingo loses her favourite cuddly toy (Floppy), so Chilli and Bluey help retrace her steps to find it. The sisters recount their adventures as they remember playing with Bandit, who was pretending to be a 'chickenrat' creature.

title: Neighbours
shortDescription: Bluey builds a pretend house and gains some new neighbours when Bingo, Chilli and Bandit move into the street.
fullSynopsis: Bluey builds a pretend house and gains some new neighbours when Bingo, Chilli and Bandit move into the street. Bluey must learn to get along with a difficult neighbour when Bingo invades her space and spills over onto her property.

title: Teasing
shortDescription: When Bluey teases Bingo, she argues that it is acceptable because Bandit always teases her.
fullSynopsis: When Bluey teases Bingo, she argues that it is acceptable because Bandit always teases her. The family recalls all of the times that Bandit has made fun of them, but they ultimately learn that there is a difference between teasing and playing.

title: Asparagus
shortDescription: Bandit tries to teach Bluey how to use manners while eating dinner at the dining table.
fullSynopsis: Bandit tries to teach Bluey how to use manners while eating dinner at the dining table. However, when Chilli gives Bluey a stick of asparagus which magically turns the family into animals, Bluey discovers the importance of manners while trying to control everyone.

title: Shaun
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo try to convince Bandit to get a pet, but he insists that they already have a pet; a disobedient emu called Shaun.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo try to convince Bandit to get a pet, but he insists that they already have a pet; a disobedient emu called Shaun. Bandit's hand transforms into Shaun and the sisters learn how to look after their new pet by feeding, bathing and walking him.

title: The Adventure
shortDescription: While Chilli is out for the night at a friend's baby shower, Bandit must put Bluey and Bingo to bed as part of their evening routine.
fullSynopsis: While Chilli is out for the night at a friend's baby shower, Bandit must put Bluey and Bingo to bed as part of their evening routine. When Bluey is missing her mother, she decides to set up a pretend baby shower of her own to take her mind off her anxiety.

title: Copycat
shortDescription: On a family trip to the beach, the Heelers discover an injured budgie and take it to the local vet.
fullSynopsis: On a family trip to the beach, the Heelers discover an injured budgie and take it to the local vet. The children learn about caring for sick animals and dealing with loss when the bird doesn't survive.

title: Zoo
shortDescription: The family visits the zoo, where Bluey becomes obsessed with seeing a certain animal.
fullSynopsis: The family visits the zoo, where Bluey becomes obsessed with seeing a certain animal. She learns about patience and appreciating what's in front of her rather than always looking for the next thing.

title: Backpackers
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo play backpackers with their parents, going on an imaginary adventure around the house and backyard.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo play backpackers with their parents, going on an imaginary adventure around the house and backyard.

title: The Show
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo put on a show for their parents, complete with costumes, music, and dramatic performances.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo put on a show for their parents, complete with costumes, music, and dramatic performances.

title: Bumpy and the Wise Old Wolfhound
shortDescription: Bluey creates a story about her toy Bumpy having an adventure with a wise old wolfhound.
fullSynopsis: Bluey creates a story about her toy Bumpy having an adventure with a wise old wolfhound.
aliases: bumpy and the wise old wolfhound

title: Camping
shortDescription: While camping, Bluey meets Jean Luc, a French-speaking boy.
fullSynopsis: While camping, Bluey meets Jean Luc, a French-speaking boy. Despite the language barrier, they play together all day. But Jean Luc is leaving tomorrow—teaching Bluey about brief but meaningful friendships.

title: Verandah Santa
shortDescription: On Christmas Eve, Bluey learns that Santa only visits children who are well-behaved, but during a game of 'Verandah Santa', she is bitten by Socks and becomes aggrieved.
fullSynopsis: On Christmas Eve, Bluey learns that Santa only visits children who are well-behaved, but during a game of 'Verandah Santa', she is bitten by Socks and becomes aggrieved. Failing to control her emotions, Bluey purposely excludes Socks from the game, before Chilli and Bandit teach her the importance of being kind-hearted throughout the whole year.

title: Dance Mode
shortDescription: When Bandit unintentionally eats Bingo's last chip at a restaurant, he makes it up to her by giving her the power of 'Dance Mode'; the ability to make her family members dance at any chosen time.
fullSynopsis: When Bandit unintentionally eats Bingo's last chip at a restaurant, he makes it up to her by giving her the power of 'Dance Mode'; the ability to make her family members dance at any chosen time. However, Bingo is frustrated when her family make the decisions for her and waste her chances to use the power.

title: Hammerbarn
shortDescription: Bandit is inspired by Pat to build a new pizza oven, so he takes the family to visit Hammerbarn, the local hardware store, for supplies.
fullSynopsis: Bandit is inspired by Pat to build a new pizza oven, so he takes the family to visit Hammerbarn, the local hardware store, for supplies. They build pretend gardens in the shopping trolley using items collected during the journey around the warehouse. Bluey continually compares her creation to Bingo's and struggles to deal with jealousy of her sister.

title: Featherwand
shortDescription: Bluey prepares to attend Chloe's birthday party, but Bingo feels dejected when she is reminded that she is not invited.
fullSynopsis: Bluey prepares to attend Chloe's birthday party, but Bingo feels dejected when she is reminded that she is not invited. Bingo discovers a magical 'featherwand' which has the ability to deliberately make items heavy upon her command, slowing down the process of Bluey and Chilli leaving the house.

title: Squash
shortDescription: During their competitive game of squash, Bluey and Bingo pretend to control Bandit and Uncle Stripe's movements.
fullSynopsis: During their competitive game of squash, Bluey and Bingo pretend to control Bandit and Uncle Stripe's movements. Bingo is disheartened when Bandit insists that older siblings always win, which leads her to inspire and motivate Uncle Stripe into winning the second round.

title: Hairdressers
shortDescription: While roleplaying as hairdressers, Bingo struggles to articulate her ideas and Bluey continually speaks on her behalf.
fullSynopsis: While roleplaying as hairdressers, Bingo struggles to articulate her ideas and Bluey continually speaks on her behalf. When the sisters discover that Bandit has nits, they must work together to combat the growing threat to their game. Bluey learns to stop and listen to Bingo's ideas, while Bingo finds her voice and learns how to be confident.

title: Stumpfest
shortDescription: Bandit, Uncle Stripe, and Pat announce their intention to remove the tree stumps from the backyard; in what they call 'Stumpfest'.
fullSynopsis: Bandit, Uncle Stripe, and Pat announce their intention to remove the tree stumps from the backyard; in what they call 'Stumpfest'. Meanwhile, Bluey, Bingo, and Muffin set up a make believe nail salon on one of the stumps, and enter a sit-in protest to stop the stump being removed by the parents, before deciding to negotiate with them.

title: Favourite Thing
shortDescription: At the dinner table, the Heelers share their favourite things that happened throughout the day.
fullSynopsis: At the dinner table, the Heelers share their favourite things that happened throughout the day. Bluey recalls her highlight and accidentally embarrasses Bingo in the process, so the family work together to retell funny moments from the day in the hope of making Bingo feel better.

title: Daddy Dropoff
shortDescription: When it is Bandit's turn to take Bluey and Bingo to school and kindergarten, the girls set out to make the morning a little more fun.
fullSynopsis: When it is Bandit's turn to take Bluey and Bingo to school and kindergarten, the girls set out to make the morning a little more fun. Bandit desperately tries to adhere to the morning routine while entertaining Bluey and Bingo's gameplay along the way.

title: Bingo
shortDescription: When Bluey is away at a play date with Chloe, Bingo tries to learn how to play by herself.
fullSynopsis: When Bluey is away at a play date with Chloe, Bingo tries to learn how to play by herself. She initially struggles to select a suitable game to play, but is inspired by Chilli to instead find a problem that needs solving. Bingo takes on the challenge of determining the colour of a kiwi to entertain herself.

title: Rug Island
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo set up the imaginative 'Rug Island' in the backyard, repurposing their play mat and felt-tip pens.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo set up the imaginative 'Rug Island' in the backyard, repurposing their play mat and felt-tip pens. While adults are not typically not allowed on the island, Bandit suddenly finds himself washed up on the beach. He is tempted to stay and rediscover his inner child, as he learns about the routines and customs of the land.

title: Charades
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo play charades with the cousins at Nana's house, but They struggle to comprehend the rules of the game.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo play charades with the cousins at Nana's house, but They struggle to comprehend the rules of the game. While She tries to cater for everyone, the cousins begin to bicker and the game quickly derails. She teaches them how to sacrifice the rules of the game to ensure that their younger cousins have fun.

title: Sticky Gecko
shortDescription: Chilli tries to get Bluey and Bingo ready to leave for a play date, but the girls are distracted by the 'sticky gecko' toy which is clinging to the ceiling.
fullSynopsis: Chilli tries to get Bluey and Bingo ready to leave for a play date, but the girls are distracted by the 'sticky gecko' toy which is clinging to the ceiling. She juggles multiple tasks at once, as Bluey and Bingo reluctantly dress and ready themselves for their meeting at the park.

title: Dad Baby
shortDescription: When Bingo finds her old baby sling, Bandit demonstrates how it works.
fullSynopsis: When Bingo finds her old baby sling, Bandit demonstrates how it works. Bluey insists that he must now pretend to be pregnant while carrying Bingo around inside of it. Bandit realises how challenging it is to be pregnant, and with the help of Pat, finally gives birth to his new baby.

title: Mum School
shortDescription: Bluey attends 'Mum School', a pretend training course in which she learns how to be a mother by looking after a group of balloons.
fullSynopsis: Bluey attends 'Mum School', a pretend training course in which she learns how to be a mother by looking after a group of balloons. Throughout the day, Bluey must learn how to manage a difficult balloon as Chilli assesses her mothering skills.

title: Trains
shortDescription: Bingo roleplays a day of carrying out errands, as she travels to each location on Bandit's pretend train, but when Bluey boards the train as an unruly passenger, the journey is delayed, and Bingo's schedule is disrupted.
fullSynopsis: Bingo roleplays a day of carrying out errands, as she travels to each location on Bandit's pretend train, but when Bluey boards the train as an unruly passenger, the journey is delayed, and Bingo's schedule is disrupted.

title: Army
shortDescription: Jack has his first day at Bluey's school, but he is worried that he will struggle to sit still and follow instructions, so he befriends Rusty, who teaches him how to play 'Army'.
fullSynopsis: Jack has his first day at Bluey's school, but he is worried that he will struggle to sit still and follow instructions, so he befriends Rusty, who teaches him how to play 'Army'. As a new recruit, Jack must follow directions from his drill sergeant Rusty.

title: Fancy Restaurant
shortDescription: Bluey and Bingo want to witness their parents kiss, so they decide to teach Bandit how to be romantic.
fullSynopsis: Bluey and Bingo want to witness their parents kiss, so they decide to teach Bandit how to be romantic. The sisters set up a pretend restaurant in the playroom, with Bluey acting as their server and Bingo becoming the chef.

title: Seesaw
shortDescription: At the park, Pom Pom feels that she is too small to fully participate in Bluey and Bingo's games.
fullSynopsis: At the park, Pom Pom feels that she is too small to fully participate in Bluey and Bingo's games. However, while playing on the seesaw, the sisters are provoked by Bandit, who uses his weight to bring the equipment's movement to a standstill. Bluey and Bingo recruit a group of their friends to overthrow Bandit from the seesaw.

title: Movies
shortDescription: Bandit takes Bluey and Bingo to the movie theatre for the first time, but Bluey is hesitant, getting worked up about the impending frightening sequence of the film.
fullSynopsis: Bandit takes Bluey and Bingo to the movie theatre for the first time, but Bluey is hesitant, getting worked up about the impending frightening sequence of the film.

title: Helicopter
shortDescription: After reading a parenting book, Bandit decides to allow Bluey and Bingo to make their own choices and develop autonomy.
fullSynopsis: After reading a parenting book, Bandit decides to allow Bluey and Bingo to make their own choices and develop autonomy. The sisters act out the procedures of a burger restaurant while in the bathtub.

title: Library
shortDescription: Uncle Stripe tells Muffin that she is 'the most special kid in the world', leading her to believe that she does not have to follow the rules.
fullSynopsis: Uncle Stripe tells Muffin that she is 'the most special kid in the world', leading her to believe that she does not have to follow the rules. This leads to conflict when They struggle to involve her in their library roleplay.

title: Barky Boats
shortDescription: At school, Bluey and Mackenzie are visited by their older buddies.
fullSynopsis: At school, Bluey and Mackenzie are visited by their older buddies. Bluey creates a fairy garden with Mia, while Mackenzie floats pieces of bark as boats with Captain.

title: Double Babysitter
shortDescription: Chilli and Bandit are both out for the night, and they accidentally double-book Uncle Rad and Bluey's godmother Frisky to babysit Bluey and Bingo.
fullSynopsis: Chilli and Bandit are both out for the night, and they accidentally double-book Uncle Rad and Bluey's godmother Frisky to babysit Bluey and Bingo.

title: Bad Mood
shortDescription: Chilli accidentally sends Bingo into a bad mood by calling her behaviour 'cheeky', leading Bingo to run to Bandit, who acts as her 'bad mood'.
fullSynopsis: Chilli accidentally sends Bingo into a bad mood by calling her behaviour 'cheeky', leading Bingo to run to Bandit, who acts as her 'bad mood'.

title: Octopus
shortDescription: Chloe is exhilarated while playing 'Octopus' at Bluey's house, and tries to replicate the experience at home with her father.
fullSynopsis: Chloe is exhilarated while playing 'Octopus' at Bluey's house, and tries to replicate the experience at home with her father.

title: Sleepytime
shortDescription: At bedtime, Bingo is determined to sleep for the whole night in her own bed, and after reading a bedtime story about outer space, she is propelled into traveling through the Solar System in her dream.
fullSynopsis: At bedtime, Bingo is determined to sleep for the whole night in her own bed, and after reading a bedtime story about outer space, she is propelled into traveling through the Solar System in her dream. Along with her stuffed toy rabbit Floppy, she imagines journeying among the planets as she unconsciously switches between the beds of the house during the night.

title: Grandad
shortDescription: Chilli takes Bluey and Bingo to visit Grandad at his home near the bush, while he is recovering from heart surgery.
fullSynopsis: Chilli takes Bluey and Bingo to visit Grandad at his home near the bush, while he is recovering from heart surgery.

title: Seesaw (Part 2)
shortDescription: Continuation of the playground adventure with Pom Pom and friends.
